title: Pak Dream Hotel & Restaurant
paragraphs: This custom-designed container project near Naran features a fully functional hotel and restaurant, built using high-quality shipping container units. The structure includes a branded front elevation, rooftop seating, and a spacious interior layout suitable for dining, kitchen, and lodging purposes. Designed to withstand the mountain climate, it offers both durability and visual appeal, making it an ideal stop for travelers on the scenic route. The project reflects Zaka Engineering’s commitment to smart, fast, and efficient modular construction.

The upper-level exterior shows easy access via a durable steel staircase, designed for safety and long-term use. The rooftop area is finished with artificial turf and railing, creating a clean and comfortable outdoor seating space — perfect for guests to enjoy the scenic mountain views. These features enhance both the functionality and appeal of the hotel’s container structure.

These interior photos highlight the cozy and inviting environment of the hotel’s dining and relaxation areas. The use of bright lighting, wooden paneling, and comfortable seating creates a warm ambiance for guests. The vibrant red and green theme adds a touch of charm, while the thoughtful layout ensures efficient use of space. These interior designs combine functionality with visual appeal, offering visitors a comfortable and memorable experience inside the container-structured hotel.

The final exterior shots showcase the completed structure of Pak Dream Hotel & Restaurant, seamlessly blending the container-based design with the natural surroundings. The clean lines, uniform paint finish, and thoughtful layout reflect a modern yet practical approach to construction. Positioned near Naran’s scenic landscape, the hotel stands as a testament to smart design and efficient use of materials, offering durability, visual appeal, and an inviting presence for visitors.

title: Portable Office
paragraphs: This portable office project was developed using a steel container, beginning with the exterior setup featuring a sleek finish and a sliding glass door. The next phase involved interior work, including electrical fittings, ceiling installation, and flooring. In the final stage, the office was fully installed on-site in G-6 Islamabad for the client, Chaudhary Zulfiqar, ready for functional use.

The interior of the portable office was designed for both functionality and comfort. It includes a clean partitioned workspace with flooring, a ceiling-mounted air conditioning system for effective climate control, and a full-size sliding glass door that allows natural light to enter while providing easy access.

title: Office Project Bahawalpur
paragraphs: This office container unit features a secure entrance door, insulated walls, and sliding windows to ensure ventilation and natural light. The exterior showcases a durable paint finish, while the interior layout is designed to provide a compact yet functional workspace.

The interior is fully equipped with essential office and utility features, including clean flooring, a storage cabinet section, and a compact washroom with a toilet and sink — offering both functionality and convenience for everyday use.

title: Noor Kitchen
paragraphs: The Noor Kitchen project utilizes bright, eye-catching yellow containers that reflect functionality with a modern aesthetic. The exterior design is simple yet purposeful, with clear branding that enhances visibility and identity. This modular setup allows for quick deployment and relocation, ideal for dynamic environments. The secure doors and clean finishes ensure both safety and weather resistance, making it suitable for long-term utility in various locations.

Inside the Noor Kitchen, the white, hygienic interior is thoughtfully arranged to ensure a clean and efficient workspace. Equipped with necessary utilities, including a sink, ventilation, lighting, and ample workspace, the design prioritizes functionality and safety. The modular structure is insulated and well-ventilated, creating a comfortable environment for staff. The layout maximizes the limited space while meeting the operational standards required for food preparation and handling.

title: Call Center Project
paragraphs: These initial images showcase the robust exterior of the call center, constructed using repurposed shipping containers—commonly transported via trucks for easy relocation. The container structure is designed for durability, mobility, and quick deployment. Its industrial aesthetic and steel-built frame offer strong resistance to environmental factors, making it an ideal solution for fast-paced commercial setups in diverse locations.

Inside, the containers are skillfully transformed into a functional call center environment. Each unit features thoughtfully arranged workstations with cubicle-style partitions, optimized for productivity and noise management. The containers’ original framework is preserved while enhancing interior space with proper insulation, lighting, and efficient layout—balancing modular utility with a professional office ambiance.

The final set of images highlights the continued use of shipping containers adapted into an extended workspace. Equipped with ample lighting and ergonomic setups, these container-based units allow for scalable business operations. Their truck-loadable design ensures the entire office can be relocated or expanded as needed, offering both flexibility and long-term usability in modular architecture.

title: Mosque Project
paragraphs: The mosque unit was constructed using modular container structures, finished in a clean white exterior to complement the surrounding greenery. Wide windows and a central entrance enhance natural light and ventilation, while the durable structure ensures long-term utility in outdoor conditions.

The interior of the mosque is designed with a spacious, serene layout ideal for prayer and gatherings. It features tiled flooring, soft lighting, proper ventilation, and minimalistic decor to maintain a peaceful environment. The space is functional, well-lit, and ready for community use.
